name: What factors should I consider when designing a guest suite?

mainEntity.name: What factors should I consider when designing a guest suite?

acceptedAnswer.text: When designing a guest suite, consider factors such as privacy, accessibility, and the comfort of future occupants. Think about whether guests will need a private entrance, dedicated parking, or accessibility features like wider doorways or a roll-in shower. Plan for ample natural light, good ventilation, and sufficient storage. Decide on the level of independence desired, from a simple bedroom/bathroom combo to a full kitchenette. Harmonize the design with your existing home's aesthetic while ensuring the space feels welcoming and self-sufficient.
acceptedAnswer.description: Key design factors for a guest suite include privacy, accessibility (e.g., separate entrance), natural light, storage, desired independence (kitchenette?), and aesthetic integration with your home.
